survey_records.wording: Whether respondents would object to public schools providing after-hours facilities for student religious groups or organizations.
survey_records.wording_note: Paraphrased summary. Split-form item base, not the full 2,041-person survey. The full national sample includes an African-American oversample and is weighted. The two forms are parts of one survey, not independent replications. Neither specifies adult leadership, children aged 6–12, parental permission or the limited-public-forum conditions. Not objecting is not a claim that access must be constitutionally required.
